professional.title: Imayl n usissen amusnaw
professional.subject: Issin Saloneo, afecku ummid i usalun-ik
professional.content:
Azul,

Bɣiɣ ad ak-d-sekneɣ Saloneo, afecku ummid n usefrek i yettwaxedmen i yisalunen n ucebbaḥ, i spa d yiḥeffafen.

S Saloneo tzemreḍ:
✓ Ad tesferkeḍ timlilin-ik srid 24/7
✓ Ad teṭṭfeḍ imsaɣen-ik s unagraw n tenqiḍin
✓ Ad tḍefreḍ igmaḍ-ik s tfelwiyin n usenqed
✓ Ad tesmektiḍ imsaɣen s SMS s wudem awurman akken ad ttwaṭṭfent kter n tmlilin
✓ Ad tesferkeḍ tarbaɛt-ik d yimeẓla-ik s sshala

Aɣawas Baṭel yeǧǧa-k ad tebduḍ war takarḍa n lbanka, war asewḥel.

Jerred tura: {{link}}

S tegrawla,
[Isem-ik]

personal.title: Imayl n usmekti udmawan
personal.subject: Tabaḍnit-iw i usefrek n usalun-iw
personal.content:
Azul,

Ssaramaɣ telhiḍ! Bɣiɣ ad ak-d-bḍuɣ afecku i seqdaceɣ i usefrek n usalun-iw.

Seg wasmi i bdiɣ Saloneo:
- Timlilin i yettwaǧǧan nqesent s 40 %
- Iḥeǧǧzen srid rnan s 60 %
- Rebḥeɣ 2 n yisragen yal ass ɣef yixeddimen n tedbelt

Ayen yelhan akk? Imsaɣen zemren ad ṭṭfen timlilit seg tiliɣri-nsen, ula ma yemdel usalun.

Ma yehwa-yak, tzemreḍ ad tebduḍ baṭel: {{link}}

Ma tesɛiḍ asteqsi, ur ttḥaz ara!

Ar tufat,
[Isem-ik]
